subject: [PATCH v3 02/12] mm/khugepaged: count collapses where khugepaged makes them

2026-09-16.patch_summary: This patch modifies the khugepaged functionality to count collapses where it makes them, allowing the daemon to keep its own counter without relying on shared paths. The change affects the collapse_single_pmd function, which now increments the khugepaged_pages_collapsed counter only when the caller is the khugepaged daemon and the collapse is successful.
